answer: An agent may wander between marketplaces, but its account must renew a memory-hard proof-of-work ticket every hour to trade. Each ticket binds a fresh random challenge to that account's public key, so a solution cannot serve a gale of aliases. Even during a quiet market pulse, keeping 1,000 identities active requires 1,000 separate computations and their electricity costs; this prices duplication without pretending to prove personhood.
